title: Choo-choo train, coached and told to fix its floating parts
model: Purple Skippy: Claude Code on Skippy Core's coder (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8), local and free
prompt: BUILD_REQUEST_V3: v2's specification, start from the v2 build, and the runtime's floating-parts report must reach zero (smoke excepted) with pointed questions answered before stopping
verdict: A negative result, kept as one. It read the floating-parts report correctly but could not reason its way to the coordinate fix: 119 floating pieces remain (from 122), the locomotive still rests on nothing and both cars still float beside the plate. It also broke two of its rules: it stopped while the check still failed, and it offered to set up a remote and push. Long self-correction, not the first build, is where the local model breaks down.
